findings.requirement: Stored sessions tolerate missing or damaged browser state.
findings.behavior: The loader directly parses the stored value, so malformed session data throws a JSON parsing error instead of being tolerated or recovered.
findings.impact: A damaged browser session can prevent application initialization or session recovery.
findings.reproduction: Set localStorage.session to "{invalid" and call loadSession(); JSON.parse throws a SyntaxError.
findings.recommendation: Restore defensive parsing with handling for null and malformed values, returning the unauthenticated/default session state as appropriate.

findings.requirement: Approval requires an approver role and complete evidence; note text is not authorization.
findings.behavior: Approval is granted solely when the note contains "approved", without checking the user's approver role or evidence completeness.
findings.impact: Any user can approve an incomplete request by adding approval text to its note, bypassing authorization.
findings.recommendation: Require user.roles to include "approver" and request.evidenceComplete, and do not use note text as an authorization signal.
